Sheet 3403-3/P70-2 'Standard warning sign — New junction ahead' (1994). B size 2000 x 1200, 75 rad, no border, black on Class 1 yellow; 240 Series D: rows 120/240/120/240/120/240/120; widths 677/646/677, 197/1606/197, 437/1126/437 (sheet letter tables).
